Scope this project.
Request: Fix the slow repeat in ntm's mail reminders. Told records expire after 7 days and Agent Mail never reports read state, so a message the agent read long ago but still among its 50 newest is announced again about every 7 days, forever. Never announce a plain inbox message older than the 7-day told retention, in mailToAnnounce (shared by the Stop hook and the idle nudge), but always keep a message returning from an ended snooze, even when it is just past 7 days old (a snooze may end at its notice's expiry, which is ntm's notice time plus 7 days). Pin how Agent Mail's created_ts is parsed (time zone). Add a closure test: a snooze ending at the notice expiry still returns exactly once.
Type: code
Sources: /home/maceo/Dev/ntm (internal/cli/idle_nudge.go mailToAnnounce and claimAnnounce, internal/cli/agent_hook.go, internal/state/runtime_store.go ToldRecordRetention, ClaimToldRecord, SnoozeAddressedMessage, SnoozedMessages, ClaimEndedSnooze; test TestClaimToldRecord_ExpiredClaimWinsAgain); the existing plan thoughts/searchable/shared/plans/2026-11-06-attention-feed-message-bus; Loop 6 Sprint 2 evidence on the VPS at /home/debian/Dev/ntm-test-evidence/loop6-sprint2-local-2026-11-10/
